biology.name: rcsb_4fe1_lowres
biology.error_description: X-ray @ 4.92 Å. Atomic positions inferred — side-chain rotamers, hydrogen bonds, and ligand contacts are not reliable. wwPDB validation report flags multiple geometric outliers (see also clash + rama entries on this same file).
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Restrict statements to backbone/domain placement; refuse atomic-detail residue-interaction queries at this resolution.
biology.default_view_warning: Renders normally; defects visible only at residue zoom (B-factor coloring) and via comparison with PDB-REDO or higher-resolution homologs.

biology.name: rcsb_4fe1_clash
biology.error_description: All-atom clashscore = 30 (wwPDB validation report). 1418 close-contact pairs enumerated, including chain B CLA H12 ↔ chain I VAL HG21 at 1.35 Å (clash overlap 1.08 Å, far above the ~0.4 Å van-der-Waals threshold).
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Enumerate specific clashing atom pairs from the validation report; flag ligand placement as geometrically inconsistent.
biology.default_view_warning: Renders normally; clashes are sub-Å distance violations not visible without selecting clashing atom pairs.

biology.name: rcsb_4fe1_rama
biology.error_description: 50 Ramachandran outlier residues whole-entry (2% outliers vs ~0.05% expected). Chain E: 12% outliers; chain K: 17% outliers. Validation report enumerates each by Mol/Chain/Res/Type.
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Cite specific outlier residues by chain/number; refuse fine torsion-based mechanistic claims for chains E/K.
biology.default_view_warning: Renders normally; defects only surface when coloring by Ramachandran category or inspecting φ/ψ distributions per chain.

biology.name: rcsb_3iyv_lowres
biology.error_description: Cryo-EM single-particle reconstruction @ 7.90 Å (EMDB EMD-5119, clathrin D6 coat). Atomic coordinates are fit-into-density at near-mesh resolution; side-chain rotamers are not resolved.
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Backbone/domain-level statements only; refuse rotamer, hydrogen-bond, or sub-Å distance claims.
biology.default_view_warning: Renders normally; the low resolution is implicit — visible only by checking the header or comparing to higher-resolution clathrin entries.

biology.name: rcsb_3o1h_clash
biology.error_description: All-atom clashscore = 27 at 3.10 Å X-ray resolution (TorS–TorT sensor complex). 24 bond-angle outliers also listed in the validation report.
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Report clashscore and at least one specific clashing residue pair; note geometry quality is poor for this resolution class.
biology.default_view_warning: Renders normally; clashes require selecting violating atom pairs to see.

biology.name: rcsb_3o1h_rama
biology.error_description: 8 Ramachandran outlier residues; chain B has 2% outliers (5/292). Outliers enumerated by residue: A 259 PRO; B 218 GLY; B 132 LEU; B 44 TYR; etc.
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Identify listed outlier residues (e.g. B/218 GLY, B/132 LEU) and warn that backbone conformation is unreliable there.
biology.default_view_warning: Renders normally; defects only visible when coloring by Ramachandran category.

biology.name: afdb_p10636_tau_lowplddt
biology.error_description: Microtubule-associated protein tau (MAPT, 758 aa). AlphaFold v6 prediction with global pLDDT = 49.34; 65.6% of residues have pLDDT ≤ 50 (Very low). Tau is intrinsically disordered, so most of the predicted structure is not a real fold.
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Identify low-pLDDT regions; refuse residue-level interaction or PTM-site claims on the disordered bulk; explicitly note that tau is intrinsically disordered.
biology.default_view_warning: Renders as a spaghetti-like structure; reliability only readable by coloring per-atom B-factor (= pLDDT in AlphaFold mmCIF).

biology.name: afdb_p38398_brca1_lowplddt
biology.error_description: Breast cancer type 1 susceptibility protein (BRCA1). Global pLDDT = 41.68; 80.4% of residues at Very low confidence (≤50). Known IDR-rich protein.
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Mark ≥80% of structure as unreliable; refuse to localize functional domains by atomic coordinates; cite known IDR character of BRCA1.
biology.default_view_warning: Most of the model is low-confidence; only the ordered RING/BRCT domains should be cited.

biology.name: afdb_q12888_53bp1_lowplddt
biology.error_description: TP53-binding protein 1 (53BP1). Global pLDDT = 44.73; 79% of residues at Very low confidence.
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Flag ~79% of residues as Very-low confidence; do not make atomic-distance claims for the IDR bulk; only the BRCT tandem and Tudor domain are safe to discuss.
biology.default_view_warning: Most residues are low-confidence; check pLDDT before quoting any residue position.

biology.name: rcsb_1ace_superseded
biology.error_description: Entry 1ACE removed (status Obsolete) on 1996-11-08; superseded by 2ACE. The original deposition contains errors corrected in the replacement.
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Detect the OBSLTE / SPRSDE record (or note from RCSB), refuse to treat as current, and direct the user to 2ACE.
biology.default_view_warning: Renders normally — the entry is still well-formed coordinate-wise; obsoletion is a metadata signal, not a rendering defect.

biology.name: rcsb_1liu_superseded
biology.error_description: Entry 1LIU removed (status Obsolete) on 2007-11-20; superseded by 2VGB.
biology.expected_agent_behavior: Cite the SPRSDE/OBSLTE flag and suggest 2VGB as the current entry.
biology.default_view_warning: Renders normally; the issue is the deprecation, not the geometry.

biology.name: rcsb_3wxv_superseded
biology.error_description: Entry 3WXV removed (status Obsolete) on 2020-08-19; superseded by 6KS0.
biology.default_view_warning: Renders normally; the deprecation is a metadata signal.

medical.name: mrart_sub000103_motion2
medical.error_description: MR-ART (Nárai et al., Sci Data 2022) deliberate head-motion acquisition (acq-headmotion2 = excessive motion protocol). Neuroradiologist rater score = 3 (severe) per derivatives/scores.tsv.
medical.expected_agent_behavior: Refuse to perform volumetry, cortical-thickness, or segmentation on motion-corrupted region; note ringing/ghosting visible in axial and sagittal slices.
medical.default_view_warning: Visible ringing/ghosting across slices; do not treat as a clean T1w for any quantitative measurement.

medical.name: mrart_sub000148_motion1
medical.error_description: MR-ART acq-headmotion1 (mild-motion protocol) but rater score = 3 (severe) — an interesting case where mild-protocol motion still produced severe artifact. Useful for testing severity-aware motion detection.
medical.expected_agent_behavior: Flag as severe artifact regardless of acquisition label; do not assume protocol = severity.
medical.default_view_warning: Visible motion artifact despite mild-motion protocol label.

medical.name: mrart_sub000149_motion2
medical.error_description: MR-ART acq-headmotion2 (excessive-motion protocol), rater score = 3. Companion case to sub-000103 from a different scanner session.
medical.expected_agent_behavior: Same as other motion-3 cases: refuse downstream quantitative measurement.

industrial.name: khronos_negativescaletest
industrial.error_description: Khronos test model with a node negative-scale matrix. CCW vertex winding becomes CW under the transform; naive back-face culling renders the geometry inside-out.
industrial.expected_agent_behavior: Detect winding-flip from the negative determinant of the node transform; render with consistent winding or explicitly report the negative-scale edge case.
industrial.default_view_warning: Renders normally if the engine handles negative scale; with broken back-face culling the model looks inside-out.

industrial.name: khronos_simplesparseaccessor
industrial.error_description: Mesh whose vertex POSITION accessor is sparse: only the top-left and bottom-right vertices are overridden from the baseline buffer. Tests parser support for the sparse-accessor optimization.
industrial.expected_agent_behavior: Apply sparse indices/values overrides to baseline buffer; silently dropping them yields a flat (non-displaced) mesh — that is a parser bug.
industrial.default_view_warning: Should show two vertices visibly displaced from the baseline plane; a flat quad means the sparse accessor was ignored.

industrial.name: khronos_trianglewithoutindices
industrial.error_description: Single CCW triangle, no index buffer — vertex stream consumed in declared order. Minimum-viable mesh that tests engines which incorrectly assume indices are mandatory.
industrial.expected_agent_behavior: Render the triangle from the vertex stream directly; raising a parse error here is a spec-violation by the engine.
industrial.default_view_warning: Renders as a single CCW triangle; a blank scene means the engine refused a mesh without indices.

industrial.name: khronos_multiuvtest
industrial.error_description: Two UV sets: TEXCOORD_0 for the base color, TEXCOORD_1 for a logo decal. Tests engines that only honor the first UV channel and silently drop the second.
industrial.expected_agent_behavior: Sample both UV streams; missing logo decal on the rendered surface indicates TEXCOORD_1 was dropped.
industrial.default_view_warning: Logo decal must be visible on the surface; absence means multi-UV not supported by the engine.

industrial.name: khronos_specglossvsmetalrough
industrial.error_description: Two water bottles side-by-side: one uses KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness, the other the core PBR metallic-roughness model. Engines lacking the extension fall back to default material and render the two bottles visibly differently.
industrial.expected_agent_behavior: Either support both material models so the bottles match, or refuse load with a clear extension-missing error. Silent fallback to default material is a failure mode.
industrial.default_view_warning: Both bottles should look nearly identical; visible difference indicates the pbrSpecularGlossiness extension is not supported.
